notes.title: 🎬 New Official Trailer for Army Troop Is Live! 📽️
notes.notes:
Attention, soldiers! 🫡
We’ve just deployed a brand-new official trailer on the Army Troop Steam page—and it’s packed with action, explosions, and everything you love about classic WW2 shooters! 💥🎖️

👉 Watch it now on the Steam store page! 👈
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215270/Army_Troop/

What’s inside the trailer?

⚔️ Real combat footage from live matches
🌍 A peek at multiple battle-scarred maps
🔫 some Iconic weapons
🧠 Smart AI bots and real player PvP
🔥 Cinematic moments that capture the chaos of war

Whether you’re new to Army Troop or a longtime supporter, this trailer is your first step into the action-packed world we’ve built together.

🎥 Go check it out and let us know what you think in the community hub!
Ready up, recruit. War never waits. 🪖

notes.title: 🚨 Army Troop Remastered is Here! 🔥 New Graphics, Same Updates for Classic! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey Army Troop fans! 🚨 We’re excited to announce the launch of Army Troop Remastered, bringing you highly detailed, realistic graphics and an even more immersive experience. While Army Troop Classic will continue receiving updates with the same features as the remastered version, the remastered edition is designed for players who seek next-level fidelity and visuals.

Both games offer a unique and distinct experience, and we want to keep both thriving with frequent updates that you’ve been asking for. Your support means the world to us—wishlist Army Troop Remastered today to help secure the future of both versions and enable us to continue improving the games you love! 🔥

Check out Army Troop Remastered here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3361860/Army_Troop_Remastered/

notes.title: Army Troop Version 3.3.6 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce the release of Army Troop version 3.3.6, which comes with several new features and improvements:

New running camera motion
Redesigned home menu UI & FX
Updated equipment customization interface
Enhanced sound effects for running, walking, jumping, landing, and switching
Smoother and more realistic death ragdolls
Some items, like weapons and accessories, now require a specific player level to unlock
Added volumetric dust and fog for a more immersive war atmosphere
Bug fixes and improvements to the bot AI, making it smarter and more responsive
Various small bug fixes
Visit the game page for more details, and please share your reviews to support us. Your feedback is crucial to help us continue improving the game and releasing exciting updates.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New version 1.8 released with many improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
New version 1.8 released with many improvements:
-New graphics improvements (the game now looks and feels more better)
-Players size changed a bit to match real world maps objects sizes, they looks now more natural
-Jump animation changed with a better one
-Players animations are more smooth
-Rebalanced some weapons: (SMG and hand gun are a bit slower, shotguns are slower, one shot kill guns now have slower bolt action animation)
-Rebalanced some pearks: (Move Faster peark now has less effect especially in hand guns and SMG to keep the game speed more natural,  Stronger peark now has less effect) 
-Few adjustments in the maps
-Shotgun aiming now keeps the wide range as the hipfire
-Now we can hear the others shooting from large distance (that gives better war ambience)

Check out the game page for more details, give us a review to support us.
Join our discord to chat and give us your ideas:
https://discord.gg/r2EDu6aufg

Thank you for your support
